<!-- hirfacare-backlog:E15-06 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/16

**User Story:**
As a coworker, I want to leave persistent structured feedback, so I can collaborate asynchronously.

**Epic:** E15 — Interactive Next.js showroom & team collaboration  
**Domain:** Frontend / Design  
**Type:** Feature  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** C — Controlled pilot — after operational gates  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Frontend/Design  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** Expanded product scope; no PDF story mapping  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:C`, `epic:E15`, `frontend`, `design`

**Dependencies:** [E01-10](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/38), [E16-05](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/78)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E01-10, E16-05.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Shared database, input validation and abuse controls required.
- [ ] Capture permitted participant, relevant screen/story, category, comment and status.
- [ ] Persist feedback in shared storage with validation and abuse/rate limits.
- [ ] Restrict viewing/moderation to intended team scope.
- [ ] Display submission errors and preserve attributable moderation history.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Use a scoped feedback API/table; support async review without automatically emailing or messaging external recipients.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Submit valid/invalid feedback, reload from a second authorized session and test unauthorized access and repeated submissions.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.
